page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; a few small marginal fragments at the right edge, and the running head at the top. Text is a column of long lines with ragged right edge.

main_text.p: loquentiæ antiftites, TULLIUS in- quam &SENECA,magno cum juvén- tutis ufu ab oblivione vindicarunt. Mag- no cum juventutis ufu: finimis faftuo, sa quædam,& Deiimperio superbè de- trectantia, aut violentas manus com- mendantia, apud scriptorem altæ gra- vitatis Senecam,ut naviganti brevia, vi- tentur. Submissior feré, & fortunæ fervilis memor, EPICTETUS secu- lo jam ad ruditatem vergente natus s- jejunitate sermonis, & sententiarum peregrinitate, antiquæ porticus situm & senium redolet.
main_text.head: EPICURI, defidiofa delectatio-
main_text.p: ne post Democritum cursum naturæ per atomos vestigantis,ʃnomen infamē reddidit divinæ providentiæ, & per eam cultus & naturæ divinæ, negatio.
main_text.head: De summo hominis bono, in volu-
main_text.p: ptatis titillatione locando,an sententia: ejus tam pecuina fuerit, utad corpus & ad inferiores animæ in corpore sensus omnia.

page.notes: Print is a dense, partly damaged early modern Latin page; the upper lines and right-edge fragments are uncertain and several words are approximated. Left margin has faint show-through and edge marks, which are omitted.
